love.note: Showcase word for the puzzy standard. Tune the views here; the canonical entry is `bundle`.

senses.gloss: A deep feeling of affection and care for a person, being or thing.

ostensive: a parent holding a sleeping child
the steadiness of a long friendship
modes.operational: If another's flourishing matters to you for its own sake, love is present.
modes.etymological: OE lufu, from PIE *leubh- ‘to care, desire’.
modes.narrative: the quiet decision to keep showing up after the feeling fades

relations.note: care is a part of love, not a synonym

senses.name: affection

senses.gloss: Romantic or sexual desire and attachment toward another person.

modes.operational: If desire and attachment single out one person, it is romantic love.

relations.note: friendship is the complement, not the opposite

senses.name: romance

senses.gloss: To enjoy or like something very much.

modes.operational: You love what you seek out for its own sake and would miss.
contrastive: not need (love can survive without it)

senses.name: enjoy

senses.gloss: A person one loves, used as a term of address.

contrastive: not a stranger (address implies intimacy or warmth)

senses.name: term of address

senses.gloss: A score of zero in tennis.

modes.operational: Announced when a player has won no points in the game.

senses.note: A homonym in the same surface form; kept as a separate sense, not a metaphor.
senses.name: tennis zero

music.why: Percussion and rhythm, played as a game: the pulse underneath love.
An electronic orchestra you conduct: love as arrangement and dynamics.
Rubbed sound: resonance and texture, the grain of a voice.

senses.gloss: An intense feeling of dislike or hostility.
Serious attention and concern for the wellbeing of someone or something.
Firm belief in the reliability, truth or strength of someone or something.
A strong feeling of wanting something or someone.
A feeling of great pleasure and happiness.
The fact or process of losing something or someone.

frames.note: The classical pair: love and hate share an object and an intensity.
The minimal triad: love without care is sentiment; care without trust is control.
Five terms that hold love without exhausting it.
The emotional weather love lives in; loss and hate are not outside it.

poly.text: Love is a quiet, private bond that matters more than anything else; it is soft rather than hard, and it looks forward without forgetting where it came from.

decks.why: Love is felt before it is seen or said; taste and smell are memory's shortcuts.
Sweetness is the obvious metaphor; umami is the savour that keeps it in the body.
Love is politicised and mediatised, then economised and judged; only rarely militarised.
Fire and water are the old pair; air is the breath of absence; earth is the home.

customDeck.title: Kinds of love
customDeck.why: Care first, friendship second, desire third; the family bond and play close the set.

nodes.title: Agape
nodes.summary: Self-giving care for another for their own sake.

nodes.title: Storge
nodes.summary: Family love, given before it is chosen.

items.title: Kinship
items.text: The love you did not audition for.

items.title: Flirtation
items.text: Love as a game with no score.

nodes.title: Pragma
nodes.summary: Enduring love built on negotiation and time.

explainers.phrase: love is the practice of caring for another's flourishing
explainers.why: because a life without it is possible but not fully human
explainers.what: a sustained orientation of attention and care toward another
explainers.how: by showing up, listening, and choosing the other's good
explainers.whatFor: so that both can grow without being owned
explainers.who: two or more people, and the bond between them
explainers.where: in the ordinary spaces of shared time
explainers.when: from first attention to last memory

formalise.axiom: Love is the sustained choice to treat another's good as one's own.
formalise.evidence: Longitudinal studies link secure attachment to wellbeing (Hazan & Shaver, 1987).
formalise.prediction: A relationship practised in care and trust will outlast one built on intensity alone.
formalise.proposal: Measure love by the reliability of care, not the height of feeling.
formalise.challenge: If love is a choice, what becomes of the loves we did not choose?

wizard.enjoy: the warmth of being chosen and choosing back
wizard.definitions: care + trust + time, with desire as an optional fire

decks.why: The minimal triad: love names the bond, care does it, trust lets it rest.
Three classical loves: desire, gift, friendship.
Sternberg's triangle in the order love usually feels it.
The relational axis: two selves and what holds them.
Love's emotional weather, in the order it arrives.
What love leaves behind: what was given, what was said, what remains.
Three ways love is expressed, from flesh to what cannot be said.
Love under test: what is lost, what is absent, what comes back.

customGroup.title: Conditions of love
customGroup.why: The three things love cannot do without.

freeGroups.why: Love moves from the personal to the social.
Love needs a reason and a practice.
Love scaled to a place and a pair of hands.

masterGroups.why: The good life: love, joy, wisdom.
Love as care for what is made and grown.

definitions.text: Love is personal in its origin and social in its effects.
Love begins as a gift and becomes an exchange without ceasing to be a gift.
Love has a reason and a method; neither alone is love.
Joy opens, love binds, wisdom holds.
